Telangana CM Praises Asaduddin Owaisi, Cites Support for AIMIM Chief

Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy praised Asaduddin Owaisi, stating the AIMIM chief is no less patriotic than Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah. Reddy, speaking at a public event, revealed the reasons for supporting Owaisi. In response, Owaisi expressed his support for Reddy, explaining the basis for his backing. The political relationship between the Congress and AIMIM in Telangana has surprised analysts and drawn questions from the opposition.
